**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `status` | query | [OrderStatus](API-Schemas.md#orderstatus) | no | Only orders with this status. None for all |
| `type` | query | [OrderType](API-Schemas.md#ordertype) | no | Only orders of this type. None for all |
| `page` | query | integer, at least 1 | no | The page, from 1 (`PageMeta.per_page` rows a page); a page past the last answers the last |

**Answers**

| Status | What it is | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | OK | [StoreOrdersResponse](#storeordersresponse) |
| `401` | [SignedOut](API-Schemas.md#response-signedout) | [ErrorResponse](API-Schemas.md#errorresponse) |
| any other | [Error](API-Schemas.md#response-error) | [ErrorResponse](API-Schemas.md#errorresponse) |

### POST /orders

Buy a plan on one of its locations, paid with `method_id`. The same checkout as the bot's purchases, at the customer's price: the lowest of the price, the first-purchase price (`first_purchase_price`, until they have bought a service) and the agent price (`agent_price`, for an agent or a member of a group with agent prices). The order is created only with the payment method. The service is named on its panel by the shop's pattern, or — while the shop offers it (`shop.name_modes` of `GET /`) — by a random name or the one the customer typed (`name_mode`, `client_name`). The wallet pays at once (the service is delivered, or the order fails and waits for support); a card waits for its receipt (`POST /payments/{id}/receipt`); an online gateway answers its page to pay on (`link`) and tells the shop once paid (`POST /payments/{id}/check` asks it sooner). A 422 on `plan_id` for a plan not on sale now (switched off, on no location that can deliver it now, or in an agent's shop more traffic than the agent has left to sell); on `server_id` for a server it is not sold on now while another location is; on `name_mode` for a way of naming the shop does not offer; on `client_name` for a typed name that is refused; on `method_id` for a method that cannot pay it, a wallet short of the price (the message says how much is missing), or an online gateway that would not open the payment (the order stays open); on `idempotency_key` for a key used for a different order or first sent with another `method_id`. A 422 (no field) while the customer has 5 unpaid orders; paid or expired orders free the room. A 422 on `status` for a card method while the shop takes one receipt at a time and the customer's last receipt is still in review (the message names its order; nothing is ordered, and the wallet still pays). A 422 on `status`, with any method, for an order whose online payment is held for support (the message names the order: nothing is paid — tell the customer not to pay again but to write to support). A 409 on `expected_amount` when the request names the amount the website showed and the order costs another now (nothing ordered; the message says the price now). A 409 when the order was paid or closed at the same moment elsewhere, or, for a repeated request, when the order was cancelled since (with its own message). A 429 with `Retry-After` past 30 ordering requests in 10 minutes (purchases, renewals and top-ups together, repeats included). A 503 while the shop takes no orders because its bot is switched off or — an agent's shop — the main shop suspended its selling (`shop.taking_orders` of `GET /`), repeats included. Repeated with the same `Idempotency-Key`, it returns the order that key made, as it is now: never a second order or a second charge.

- **Who:** the signed-in customer ([the customer scheme](#the-customer-scheme)).

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | string matching `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$` | yes | A key the website makes for each checkout attempt (a UUID), and a new one when the customer picks another payment method: 1 to 64 Latin letters, digits, `-` and `_`. Repeating the request with the same key and `method_id` (a network retry) returns the order the key led to, either the one it created or the open order for the same thing it found and paid, as it is now. Never a second order or charge, whatever changed since: even after a price change it is the order made at the old price. Two identical requests at the same moment get one order and one answer. If the order was cancelled since (by support, or left unpaid past its deadline, maybe days ago), the answer is a 409 with its own message («این سفارش لغو شده است…»), unlike the 409 for an order closed elsewhere a moment ago: buying again is a new attempt with a new key. A key already used for a different order (another type, plan, server or service, or a top-up of another amount), or first sent with another `method_id`, is a 422 on `idempotency_key`; so is a missing or malformed key. A key is remembered for a week; after that, a request with it counts as new. |

**Body**, as JSON:

A purchase: the plan, the location to buy it on, and the payment method.

| Field | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `plan_id` | integer | yes | A plan on sale now (`GET /plans`). |
| `server_id` | integer | yes | One of the plan's `locations`. |
| `method_id` | integer | yes | A payment method for purchases (`GET /payment-methods?for=purchase`). |
| `name_mode` | [StoreNameModeInput](#storenamemodeinput) | no |  |
| `client_name` | [StoreClientNameInput](#storeclientnameinput) | no |  |
| `discount_code` | string or null | no | A discount code the customer typed (any case, Persian digits accepted), applied after the automatic discount. A 422 on `discount_code` when it does not apply to this order. Blank, null or left out for none. Each code that does not apply uses one of the customer's 20 tries an hour (then a 429). A repeated request with the same key returns its order, whatever the code says now. |
| `expected_amount` | [AmountInput](API-Schemas.md#amountinput) or null | no | The amount the website showed the customer for this order, in Toman: its quote's `amount` (or the price it showed: a plan's or an extra's `offer_price`, a renewal's `price`) as the API gave it, "120000.00" (whole Toman as a JSON number, or with Persian digits and separators, is read too). Sent, the order is paid at that amount alone: when it costs another now — a sale ended, a first purchase paid elsewhere, a discount gone or a day of extra devices passed since the page was drawn — it is a 409 on `expected_amount` saying the price now («قیمت این سفارش تغییر کرده و الان ۱۲۰٬۰۰۰ تومان است؛ اگر هنوز می‌خواهید، دوباره پرداخت کنید.»), with nothing ordered or charged: show the new price and let the customer pay again. A request repeated with its `Idempotency-Key` is held to the amount of the order that key made while it is still to be paid (once paid or closed, it is answered as it stands). A 422 on `expected_amount` for an amount that is no whole Toman. Blank, null or left out: paid at the price of the moment. |

**Answers**

| Status | What it is | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | The checkout's outcome | [StoreCheckoutResponse](#storecheckoutresponse) |
| `401` | [SignedOut](API-Schemas.md#response-signedout) | [ErrorResponse](API-Schemas.md#errorresponse) |
| any other | [Error](API-Schemas.md#response-error) | [ErrorResponse](API-Schemas.md#errorresponse) |

| `id` | path | integer | yes | The row's id. A row of another shop, or on the Store API another customer's, is a 404 as a missing one is |

**Answers**

| Status | What it is | Body |

| `200` | OK | [StoreOrderResponse](#storeorderresponse) |
| `401` | [SignedOut](API-Schemas.md#response-signedout) | [ErrorResponse](API-Schemas.md#errorresponse) |

### POST /payments/{id}/receipt

Upload the receipt of a card transfer. For the payment the checkout returned (`transfer.payment_id`): a picture, with an optional note from the customer. Support always reviews it (in the panel or the report group): a card method's automatic approval window applies only to receipts sent in the bot, never to uploads. Returns the order, with the payment awaiting review. A 404 for another customer's payment; a 422 on `status` while the payment awaits no receipt (one was already sent, or it was rejected, paid, cancelled, or is not a card transfer), or while the shop takes one receipt at a time and another receipt of the customer's is still in review (the message names its order), on `file` when it is not a JPEG, PNG or WebP of at most 10 MB, or on `note` when it is too long. A 429 with `Retry-After` past 10 pictures in an hour (receipts and ticket pictures share this budget). A 503 while the host has less than 200 MB of free disk, once the shop's uploads for the day reach 1024 MB, or while the shop takes no orders (its bot is switched off). A form larger than PHP accepts is a 413; a form field that is not UTF-8 is a 422 on that field.

- **Who:** the signed-in customer ([the customer scheme](#the-customer-scheme)).

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | integer | yes | The row's id. A row of another shop, or on the Store API another customer's, is a 404 as a missing one is |

**Body**, as a form (`multipart/form-data`):

A card transfer's receipt, as a browser form uploads it.

| Field | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `file` | file | yes | The picture: a JPEG, PNG or WebP (checked by its content), at most 10 MB. |
| `note` | string | no | An optional note for support, at most 1024 characters; blank for none. |

**Answers**

| Status | What it is | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Accepted; the order, with the payment awaiting review | [StoreOrderResponse](#storeorderresponse) |
| `401` | [SignedOut](API-Schemas.md#response-signedout) | [ErrorResponse](API-Schemas.md#errorresponse) |
| any other | [Error](API-Schemas.md#response-error) | [ErrorResponse](API-Schemas.md#errorresponse) |

### POST /payments/{id}/check

Ask an online payment's gateway what came of it now — when the customer comes back from the gateway's page, or presses a «I paid» button. The gateway tells the shop by itself as well, and the shop asks it every few minutes until its page has been closed a while: this only makes it sooner. A payment the gateway says was paid is settled at once — its order paid and delivered (or, its order closed meanwhile, the money put in the wallet) — and the customer gets the notice of it; one whose page closed unpaid fails, its order left open to pay again. Answers what the gateway said, the order as it stands now and, once delivered, its service. A 404 for another customer's payment; a 422 on `status` for a payment that is not an online one (a card transfer, the wallet), and for one held for support and still waiting, before or by this very ask — the gateway's answer did not fit it (another order or amount), it kept money on it unsettled for two days, or it closed it after saying money had come in on it —, the message naming its order: tell the customer not to pay again but to write to support. A 503 while the gateway cannot be asked, saying so (nothing changed: if they paid, ask again a little later). At most 10 a minute per customer, then a 429 with `Retry-After`.

- **Who:** the signed-in customer ([the customer scheme](#the-customer-scheme)).

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | integer | yes | The row's id. A row of another shop, or on the Store API another customer's, is a 404 as a missing one is |

**Body:** none.

**Answers**

| Status | What it is | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | What the gateway said, and the order as it stands | [StorePaymentCheckResponse](#storepaymentcheckresponse) |
| `401` | [SignedOut](API-Schemas.md#response-signedout) | [ErrorResponse](API-Schemas.md#errorresponse) |
| any other | [Error](API-Schemas.md#response-error) | [ErrorResponse](API-Schemas.md#errorresponse) |

### POST /wallet/top-up

Top up the wallet by `amount`, paid with `method_id`. The amount must be within the `top_up` limits of `GET /wallet` (else a 422 on `amount` stating them). Any method but the wallet itself (else a 422 on `method_id`). A card waits for its receipt (`POST /payments/{id}/receipt`); an online gateway answers its page (`link`). Once paid, the amount is added to the balance. Refused like `POST /orders` for too many unpaid orders or a receipt still in review (422), past the checkout's rate limit (429) and while the shop takes no orders (503). Repeated with the same `Idempotency-Key`, it returns the top-up that key made, as it is now.

- **Who:** the signed-in customer ([the customer scheme](#the-customer-scheme)).

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | string matching `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$` | yes | A key the website makes for each checkout attempt (a UUID), and a new one when the customer picks another payment method: 1 to 64 Latin letters, digits, `-` and `_`. Repeating the request with the same key and `method_id` (a network retry) returns the order the key led to, either the one it created or the open order for the same thing it found and paid, as it is now. Never a second order or charge, whatever changed since: even after a price change it is the order made at the old price. Two identical requests at the same moment get one order and one answer. If the order was cancelled since (by support, or left unpaid past its deadline, maybe days ago), the answer is a 409 with its own message («این سفارش لغو شده است…»), unlike the 409 for an order closed elsewhere a moment ago: buying again is a new attempt with a new key. A key already used for a different order (another type, plan, server or service, or a top-up of another amount), or first sent with another `method_id`, is a 422 on `idempotency_key`; so is a missing or malformed key. A key is remembered for a week; after that, a request with it counts as new. |

**Body**, as JSON:

A wallet top-up: how much, and the payment method.

| Field | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `amount` | [WholeNumberInput](API-Schemas.md#wholenumberinput) | yes | Whole Toman, within the `top_up` limits of `GET /wallet`. As a customer types it (a JSON number or text; Persian digits, thousands separators and «تومان» accepted), or in the API's own amount format ("50000.00", with a zero fraction). |
| `method_id` | integer | yes | A payment method for top-ups, any but the wallet itself (`GET /payment-methods?for=wallet_topup`). |

**Answers**

| Status | What it is | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | The checkout's outcome | [StoreCheckoutResponse](#storecheckoutresponse) |
| `401` | [SignedOut](API-Schemas.md#response-signedout) | [ErrorResponse](API-Schemas.md#errorresponse) |
| any other | [Error](API-Schemas.md#response-error) | [ErrorResponse](API-Schemas.md#errorresponse) |

### GET /wallet/transfer

«انتقال موجودی», before it is done: who the shop's customer with this numeric Telegram id is (their Telegram name and handle), so the website asks the customer to confirm them before `POST`. The same refusals as `POST` about the recipient, nothing changed: a 422 on `status` while the shop offers none (`transfer` of `GET /wallet` is null); on `amount` while the customer can send nothing now — less than `min` in the wallet, or the daily cap used up (its `most` below `min`) —, before any id is looked up; on `telegram_id` for an id that is no number, that names no customer of this shop (they must have started the bot once), the customer themselves, or a banned account. Each look-up counts: at most 10 in 10 minutes per customer, together with `GET /subscriptions/{id}/transfer`, then a 429 with `Retry-After`.

- **Who:** the signed-in customer ([the customer scheme](#the-customer-scheme)).

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `telegram_id` | query | string | yes | The recipient's numeric Telegram id (Persian digits are read too). |

**Answers**

| Status | What it is | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Who would receive the money | [StoreTransferRecipientResponse](#storetransferrecipientresponse) |
| `401` | [SignedOut](API-Schemas.md#response-signedout) | [ErrorResponse](API-Schemas.md#errorresponse) |
| any other | [Error](API-Schemas.md#response-error) | [ErrorResponse](API-Schemas.md#errorresponse) |

### POST /wallet/transfer

«انتقال موجودی»: send `amount` from the wallet to another customer of the shop, found by their numeric Telegram id — as the bot does it, with no fee. Only while the shop offers it (`transfer` of `GET /wallet`, off by default), and only from the wallet's own balance, never an agent's credit. The recipient's wallet gets the whole amount at once; each wallet's ledger has a line naming the other customer («انتقال موجودی به …», «دریافت موجودی از …»); the recipient is told in the bot and among their notices (`wallet_received`), this customer among their notices and in Telegram (`wallet_sent`); the report group hears of it. A 403 when the session's sign-in is not recent (call `POST /me/reauthenticate` first): a bearer token alone gives no money away. A 422 on `status` while the shop offers none; on `telegram_id` as `GET` refuses it; on `amount` for no whole number of Toman, below `min` or above `max`, more than the balance, or past the daily cap (the message says what today leaves); on `idempotency_key` for a missing or malformed key, or one sent before with another recipient or amount. It looks the recipient up as `GET` does (one of its 10 in 10 minutes); at most 10 transfers an hour per customer, then a 429 with `Retry-After`. Repeated with the same `Idempotency-Key`, it answers the transfer that key made, with the wallet as it is now: never a second transfer.

- **Who:** the signed-in customer ([the customer scheme](#the-customer-scheme)).

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | string matching `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$` | yes | A key the website makes for each «انتقال موجودی» the customer confirms (a UUID): 1 to 64 Latin letters, digits, `-` and `_`. Repeating the request with the same key (a network retry) answers the transfer the key made, never a second one — even when two arrive at the same moment. The same key with another `telegram_id` or `amount` is a 422 on `idempotency_key`; so is a missing or malformed key. A key is the customer's for good: a new transfer takes a new key. |

**Body**, as JSON:

«انتقال موجودی»: whom to send money to — a customer of the shop, by their numeric Telegram id; they must have started the bot once — and how much.

| Field | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `telegram_id` | [WholeNumberInput](API-Schemas.md#wholenumberinput) | yes | Their numeric Telegram id: a number, or its digits as typed. |
| `amount` | [WholeNumberInput](API-Schemas.md#wholenumberinput) | yes | Whole Toman, from `transfer.min` to `transfer.most` of `GET /wallet`. As a customer types it (a JSON number or text; Persian digits, thousands separators and «تومان» accepted), or in the API's own amount format ("50000.00", with a zero fraction). |

**Answers**

| Status | What it is | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Sent: the transfer, and the wallet as it is now | [StoreWalletTransferResponse](#storewallettransferresponse) |
| `401` | [SignedOut](API-Schemas.md#response-signedout) | [ErrorResponse](API-Schemas.md#errorresponse) |
| `403` | [SignInAgain](API-Schemas.md#response-signinagain) | [ErrorResponse](API-Schemas.md#errorresponse) |
| any other | [Error](API-Schemas.md#response-error) | [ErrorResponse](API-Schemas.md#errorresponse) |

### POST /discount-codes/check

Check a discount code before paying. Returns the quote the order would be made at: the base price (the customer's price for the plan, or the cost of that much extra), the automatic discount and the code's discount as lines, and the total. Nothing is ordered. A 422 on `code` when it does not apply: unknown in this shop, switched off, outside its dates, for another type of order, plan or server, only for a first purchase, for a larger order, or used up. The rest of the request is refused as its checkout would refuse it: a 422 on `plan_id`, `server_id`, `status`, `gb`, `days` or `devices`, a 404 for a service not theirs — in an agent's shop whose selling the main shop suspended, a purchase on `plan_id` and a renewal or an extra on `status`, where the checkout answers a 503. Each code that does not apply uses one of the customer's 20 tries an hour (shared with the checkout's `discount_code`), then a 429 with `Retry-After`.

- **Who:** the signed-in customer ([the customer scheme](#the-customer-scheme)).

**Body**, as JSON:

A discount code and what the customer wants to buy with it, named as in the checkout's own request.

| Field | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `code` | string | yes | As the customer typed it (any case, Persian digits accepted). |
| `for` | [OwnOrderType](API-Schemas.md#ownordertype) | yes |  |
| `plan_id` | integer | no | For a purchase: a plan on sale now (`GET /plans`). For a renewal of a service without a plan: the plan picked (`GET …/renewal-plans`). |
| `server_id` | integer | no | For a purchase: one of the plan's `locations`. A code limited to certain servers is refused until one is picked. |
| `subscription_id` | integer | no | For a renewal or extra: the customer's service. |
| `method` | [RenewalMethod](API-Schemas.md#renewalmethod) | no | For a renewal: the renewal method, as the renewal would send it (a 422 on `method` for one the shop does not offer). |
| `gb` | [WholeNumberInput](API-Schemas.md#wholenumberinput) | no | For extra traffic: how many GB. For a renewal with a package built (instead of `plan_id`): its GB. |
| `days` | [WholeNumberInput](API-Schemas.md#wholenumberinput) | no | For extra time: how many days. For a renewal with a package built: its days. |
| `devices` | [WholeNumberInput](API-Schemas.md#wholenumberinput) | no | For extra devices: how many. |

**Answers**

| Status | What it is | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | OK | [StoreDiscountQuoteResponse](#storediscountquoteresponse) |
| `401` | [SignedOut](API-Schemas.md#response-signedout) | [ErrorResponse](API-Schemas.md#errorresponse) |
| any other | [Error](API-Schemas.md#response-error) | [ErrorResponse](API-Schemas.md#errorresponse) |

### POST /gift-codes/redeem

Redeem a gift code, as the bot's «🎁 کد هدیه» does. The code may be typed in any case, with dashes and spaces anywhere and Persian digits. Toman are added to the wallet; a plan code delivers a free service (the answer has its order and, once delivered, the service; nothing is sent in Telegram). A 422 on `code` when the shop takes no codes now, the code does not exist, is already redeemed (by them or someone else) or expired, or its service cannot be delivered now (the code stays theirs to try again). Every try that names no code of the shop counts against the customer and their address network: 10 wrong tries an hour per customer and 30 per network, then a 429 with `Retry-After`.

- **Who:** the signed-in customer ([the customer scheme](#the-customer-scheme)).

**Body**, as JSON:

| Field | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `code` | string | yes | The gift code as the customer typed it. |

**Answers**

|---|---|---|
| `200` | Redeemed | [StoreGiftCodeResponse](#storegiftcoderesponse) |
| `401` | [SignedOut](API-Schemas.md#response-signedout) | [ErrorResponse](API-Schemas.md#errorresponse) |
| any other | [Error](API-Schemas.md#response-error) | [ErrorResponse](API-Schemas.md#errorresponse) |

| `200` | OK | [StoreTicketsResponse](#storeticketsresponse) |
| `401` | [SignedOut](API-Schemas.md#response-signedout) | [ErrorResponse](API-Schemas.md#errorresponse) |
| any other | [Error](API-Schemas.md#response-error) | [ErrorResponse](API-Schemas.md#errorresponse) |

### POST /tickets

Open a support ticket. Send the subject, the first message, optionally the customer's service it is about, and optionally a picture (as a form). It waits for support, and the report group is notified at once. A 422 on `subject` (3 to 120 characters), `body` (1 to 4000), `subscription_id` (not the customer's) or `file` (a JPEG, PNG or WebP of at most 10 MB). A 429 with `Retry-After` past 10 tickets in an hour, 30 messages in 10 minutes, or 10 pictures in an hour (receipts and ticket pictures together). A 503 while the host has less than 200 MB of free disk, or once the shop's uploads for the day reach 1024 MB. A form larger than PHP accepts is a 413; a form field that is not UTF-8 is a 422 on that field.

- **Who:** the signed-in customer ([the customer scheme](#the-customer-scheme)).

**Body**, as JSON:

A new ticket: its subject, its first message, and optionally the customer's service it is about. To attach a picture, send a form instead (StoreTicketUploadRequest).

| Field | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `subject` | string | yes | 3 to 120 characters. |
| `body` | string | yes | 1 to 4000 characters; line breaks are kept. |
| `subscription_id` | [WholeNumberInput](API-Schemas.md#wholenumberinput) or null | no | One of the customer's services (`GET /subscriptions`). Left out, null or blank: about no service. |

**Body**, as a form (`multipart/form-data`):

A new ticket with a picture in its first message, as a browser form uploads it. A form without a file opens it without a picture.

| Field | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `subject` | string | yes | 3 to 120 characters. |
| `body` | string | yes | 1 to 4000 characters; line breaks are kept. |
| `subscription_id` | [WholeNumberInput](API-Schemas.md#wholenumberinput) or null | no | One of the customer's services (`GET /subscriptions`). Left out, null or blank: about no service. |
| `file` | file | no | The picture: a JPEG, PNG or WebP (checked by its content), at most 10 MB. Optional. |

**Answers**

| Status | What it is | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | Opened | [StoreTicketResponse](#storeticketresponse) |
| `401` | [SignedOut](API-Schemas.md#response-signedout) | [ErrorResponse](API-Schemas.md#errorresponse) |
| any other | [Error](API-Schemas.md#response-error) | [ErrorResponse](API-Schemas.md#errorresponse) |

### GET /tickets/{id}

One of the customer's tickets, with its whole conversation. Reading it does not mark it read (`POST /tickets/{id}/read` does). Another customer's ticket is a 404.

- **Who:** the signed-in customer ([the customer scheme](#the-customer-scheme)).

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | integer | yes | The row's id. A row of another shop, or on the Store API another customer's, is a 404 as a missing one is |

**Answers**

| Status | What it is | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | OK | [StoreTicketResponse](#storeticketresponse) |
| `401` | [SignedOut](API-Schemas.md#response-signedout) | [ErrorResponse](API-Schemas.md#errorresponse) |
| any other | [Error](API-Schemas.md#response-error) | [ErrorResponse](API-Schemas.md#errorresponse) |

### POST /tickets/{id}/read

Mark a ticket as read. Call it once the website has shown the ticket: support's latest messages become read (`unread` false), and so do the notifications about it. Returns the ticket. Another customer's ticket is a 404.

- **Who:** the signed-in customer ([the customer scheme](#the-customer-scheme)).

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | integer | yes | The row's id. A row of another shop, or on the Store API another customer's, is a 404 as a missing one is |

**Body:** none.

**Answers**

| Status | What it is | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Marked as read | [StoreTicketResponse](#storeticketresponse) |
| `401` | [SignedOut](API-Schemas.md#response-signedout) | [ErrorResponse](API-Schemas.md#errorresponse) |
| any other | [Error](API-Schemas.md#response-error) | [ErrorResponse](API-Schemas.md#errorresponse) |

### POST /tickets/{id}/messages

Write a message in a ticket. Send the text, and optionally a picture (as a form). The ticket waits for support again (a closed ticket reopens and its rating is cleared), and the report group gets the message. A 422 on `body` or `file`; on `file` also once the ticket has 20 pictures the customer uploaded; on `status` once it has 200 messages (open a new ticket instead). A 429 with `Retry-After` past 30 messages in 10 minutes, or 10 pictures in an hour (receipts and ticket pictures together). A 503 while the host has less than 200 MB of free disk, or once the shop's uploads for the day reach 1024 MB. A form larger than PHP accepts is a 413; a form field that is not UTF-8 is a 422 on that field.

- **Who:** the signed-in customer ([the customer scheme](#the-customer-scheme)).

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | integer | yes | The row's id. A row of another shop, or on the Store API another customer's, is a 404 as a missing one is |

**Body**, as JSON:

A ticket message's text: support's answer on a panel, or the customer's message on the website. To attach a picture, send a form instead (TicketMessageUploadRequest).

| Field | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `body` | string | yes | 1 to 4000 characters; line breaks are kept. |

**Body**, as a form (`multipart/form-data`):

A ticket message with a picture, as a browser form uploads it. A form without a file is a message without a picture.

| Field | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `body` | string | yes | 1 to 4000 characters; line breaks are kept. |
| `file` | file | no | The picture: a JPEG, PNG or WebP (checked by its content), at most 10 MB. Optional. |

**Answers**

| Status | What it is | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Written | [StoreTicketResponse](#storeticketresponse) |
| `401` | [SignedOut](API-Schemas.md#response-signedout) | [ErrorResponse](API-Schemas.md#errorresponse) |
| any other | [Error](API-Schemas.md#response-error) | [ErrorResponse](API-Schemas.md#errorresponse) |

### GET /tickets/{id}/messages/{message}/attachment

A ticket message's picture, as bytes. A 404 when the message has no picture or it is gone (`attachment.kept` false says so in advance), or for another customer's ticket. A 502 while Telegram cannot be reached. A 429 with `Retry-After` past 120 reads an hour per customer, refused reads included.

- **Who:** the signed-in customer ([the customer scheme](#the-customer-scheme)).

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | integer | yes | The row's id. A row of another shop, or on the Store API another customer's, is a 404 as a missing one is |
| `message` | path | integer | yes | A message of the ticket (`TicketMessageRow.id`) |

**Answers**

| Status | What it is | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [TicketPicture](API-Schemas.md#response-ticketpicture) | the bytes, as `image/jpeg`, `image/png`, `image/webp`, `image/gif`, `application/octet-stream` |
| `401` | [SignedOut](API-Schemas.md#response-signedout) | [ErrorResponse](API-Schemas.md#errorresponse) |
| any other | [Error](API-Schemas.md#response-error) | [ErrorResponse](API-Schemas.md#errorresponse) |

Close a ticket. The report group is notified. A 422 on `status` when it is already closed.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | integer | yes | The row's id. A row of another shop, or on the Store API another customer's, is a 404 as a missing one is |

### POST /tickets/{id}/rating

Rate a closed ticket, 1 to 5 with an optional note. A new rating replaces the previous one; the report group hears of a first or changed rating. A 422 on `rating` or `note` (at most 500 characters), then on `status` while the ticket is not closed. A 429 with `Retry-After`: each rating counts as one of the customer's 30 messages per 10 minutes.

- **Who:** the signed-in customer ([the customer scheme](#the-customer-scheme)).

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | integer | yes | The row's id. A row of another shop, or on the Store API another customer's, is a 404 as a missing one is |

**Body**, as JSON:

The customer's rating of a closed ticket. It replaces any earlier rating.

| Field | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rating` | [WholeNumberInput](API-Schemas.md#wholenumberinput) | yes | 1 to 5. |
| `note` | string | no | An optional note, at most 500 characters; blank for none. |

**Answers**

| Status | What it is | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Rated | [StoreTicketResponse](#storeticketresponse) |
| `401` | [SignedOut](API-Schemas.md#response-signedout) | [ErrorResponse](API-Schemas.md#errorresponse) |
| any other | [Error](API-Schemas.md#response-error) | [ErrorResponse](API-Schemas.md#errorresponse) |

## Schemas

### CaptchaAction

The action a captcha widget names for a form: the shop's `sign_up`, `sign_in`, `password_reset` and `review` (each operation's `x-captcha`), or the site's own (such as `contact`). A token solved for one action does not pass a form of another. 1 to 32 of A-Z, a-z, 0-9, - and _ (Turnstile's data-action).

String matching `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,32}$`.

### CaptchaDriver

A captcha a website can use: `turnstile`, Cloudflare Turnstile (its widget is drawn with the site key and its token is checked with Cloudflare); or `altcha`, ALTCHA (open source, with no third party and no keys: the visitor's browser solves a challenge the shop issues and checks itself).

String: `turnstile`, `altcha`.

### ClientNameMode

How a buyer has their new service named: `sequential` by the shop's pattern, `random`, or `custom` (the name they type) — the latter two while the shop offers them.

String: `sequential`, `random`, `custom`.

### StoreAccountResponse

The answer of `GET /me` and `PATCH /me`: the account, the unread notification count (for a bell icon), what the admin API allows them (for an admin of the shop), and their loyalty standing.

| Field | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `customer` | [StoreCustomer](#storecustomer) | yes |  |
| `unread_notifications` | integer | yes | How many of their notifications are unread (`GET /notifications`). |
| `staff` | [StoreStaff](#storestaff) or null | yes | Null for a customer who is not an admin of the shop, and while the website lets no admins in. |
| `loyalty` | [LoyaltyStanding](API-Schemas.md#loyaltystanding) | yes | Their loyalty tier («سطح وفاداری»), what they spent and the next tier. The tier's discount applies at checkout and its cashback adds to the shop's. In a shop with no tiers, `tier` and `next` are null. |

### StoreAuthorizeResponse

| Field | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `url` | string | yes | Telegram's authorization address to send the browser to, with client_id, redirect_uri, scope, state, the PKCE challenge (S256) and a nonce. |

### StoreCaptchaChallengeResponse

An ALTCHA challenge, in the widget's own format: a salt that carries its expiry (and the requested action), the SHA-256 of the salt plus a number up to `maxnumber`, and the shop's signature. The widget finds the number and gives the form the payload (base64 JSON), which the form sends as `captcha`.

| Field | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `algorithm` | string: `SHA-256` | yes |  |
| `challenge` | string | yes |  |
| `maxnumber` | integer | yes |  |
| `salt` | string | yes |  |
| `signature` | string | yes |  |

### StoreCaptchaVerdict

The result of a token check: whether it passed, the action and host it was solved for (as far as the captcha reports), when it was checked, and why it failed.

| Field | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `passed` | boolean | yes |  |
| `action` | string or null | yes | The action it was solved for, as the widget named it; null for none. |
| `hostname` | string or null | yes | The host it was solved on (Turnstile reports it); null when the captcha does not report it (ALTCHA). |
| `verified_at` | string (date-time) | yes |  |
| `reasons` | list of string | yes | Why it failed; empty when it passed. `hostname-mismatch` (not solved on one of the website's hosts: its address and origins), `action-mismatch` (solved for another action than `action`), `timeout-or-duplicate` (expired, or already used), `invalid-input-response` (not a valid token, or tampered with), `missing-input-response`, and Cloudflare's own error codes. |

### StoreCheckout

The outcome of a checkout (a purchase, renewal, extra traffic, time or devices, or top-up). A checkout that paid nothing is a refusal instead: a wallet short of the price (a 422 on `method_id`, saying how much is missing), a price another than the website showed (a 409 on `expected_amount`, saying the price now), an online gateway that would not open the payment (a 422 on `method_id`, in the customer's words; the order stays open), an order whose online payment is held for support (a 422 on `status`, naming the order), or an order paid or closed at the same moment elsewhere (a 409).

| Field | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outcome` | string: `settled`, `transfer`, `link`, `processing` | yes | `settled`: paid at once (by the wallet). The order is `fulfilled` (the service is in `subscription`) or `failed` (the money is taken and support will finish it; the order's internal notes are never shown). Also returned when a repeated request's order was paid since (by card or online too) and is finished: delivered, failed or `refunded`. `transfer`: transfer to the card in `transfer`, then upload the receipt (`POST /payments/{id}/receipt`); the payment waits for the receipt, or support has it. `link`: pay on the online gateway's page in `link`; the gateway tells the shop by itself, and `POST /payments/{id}/check` asks it now. `processing`: paid, and the delivery is in progress. |
| `order` | [StoreOrder](#storeorder) | yes |  |
| `transfer` | object or null | yes | For `transfer`: where to send the money, and the payment the receipt is for. Null otherwise. A payment taken in support's private chat (made while the bot setting «هدایت پرداخت کارت به کارت به پیوی پشتیبانی» is on) is shown no card: `card`, `holder` and `bank` are null and `contact` says where to go — tell the customer to send the order's number there, get the card from support, and send the receipt to support too; support approves the payment in its panel. |
| `transfer.payment_id` | integer | yes | The payment to upload the receipt for. |
| `transfer.amount` | string | yes | The amount to transfer, in Toman: the payment's own. A wallet top-up's may be a few Toman more than the order's (the bot setting of a random sum added to card-to-card top-ups), so its receipt is told apart; the whole of it is credited. |
| `transfer.card` | string or null | yes | The card number: 16 digits, no separators. Each payment is shown one of its method's cards, picked at random, and always that one after — the same card on a request made again. Null while the card is given in support's private chat (`contact`). |
| `transfer.holder` | string or null | yes | The card holder's name. Null while the card is given in support's private chat (`contact`). |
| `transfer.bank` | string or null | yes | The shop's word for the card, such as its bank; null for none, and while the card is given in support's private chat. |
| `transfer.instructions` | string or null | yes | The shop's payment instructions (the method's note), shown with the card or with the way to support, as the bot shows them; null if none. |
| `transfer.contact` | object or null | yes | While the shop takes card payments in support's private chat: how to reach support. Null while the card is shown. |
| `transfer.contact.text` | string | yes | Support's contact as the shop wrote it (a Telegram handle, a link, a phone number). |
| `transfer.contact.url` | string or null | yes | It as a link to open: a handle as its t.me address, a web or t.me address, a phone number as `tel:`; null when it is none of these. |
| `link` | [StorePayLink](#storepaylink) or null | yes | For `link`: the online gateway's page to pay on, and the payment it is for. Null otherwise. |
| `subscription` | [StoreSubscription](#storesubscription) or null | yes | Once delivered: the service a purchase created, a renewal renewed or extras were added to. Null otherwise, and on a repeated request once the service is no longer the customer's (handed to another customer). |

### StoreCheckoutResponse

| Field | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `checkout` | [StoreCheckout](#storecheckout) | yes |  |

### StoreClientNameInput

For `custom`: the name the customer typed, 3 to 32 English letters, digits, `_` and `-`. A 422 on `client_name` for another character or length, for one that server's panel does not take (a PasarGuard server: two of `_` and `-` side by side), or for a name a service on that server already has. Should a service (or a client made by hand on the panel) take it before the order is delivered, the service is named by the shop's pattern instead. Ignored for the other ways.

String.

### StoreCustomQuantity

One quantity of a built service. Any whole amount from `min` to `max` may be chosen; it is priced whole at the `price` of the last tier whose `from` it reaches (50 with tiers from 1 at 3000 and from 50 at 2500 costs 50 × 2500). The tiers start at `min`: none prices an amount outside the bounds.

| Field | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tiers` | list of [PriceTier](API-Schemas.md#pricetier) | yes | The smallest `from` first; empty while it is not priced, or nothing is offered. |
| `min` | integer | yes |  |
| `max` | integer | yes |  |
| `options` | list of integer | yes | The amounts offered as buttons, smallest first, each within the bounds; empty while nothing is offered. |

### StoreCustomQuoteResponse

| Field | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `quote` | object | yes | What the service would give and cost: its GB, days and devices, each quantity's price, and the price as a `StoreQuote` (`base` is the two prices added). |
| `quote.gb` | integer | yes |  |
| `quote.days` | integer | yes |  |
| `quote.devices` | integer | yes | Devices at once on the service; 0 — unlimited. |
| `quote.server_id` | integer or null | yes | The server named; null for none. |
| `quote.traffic_price` | string | yes | Toman: the GB at their tier's rate. |
| `quote.days_price` | string | yes | Toman: the days at their tier's rate. |
| `quote.base` | string | yes | Toman before discounts: the customer's price for what they mean to buy — a plan's price, first-purchase price or agent price; an extra amount's cost; a built service's two prices added. |
| `quote.discounts` | list of [DiscountLine](API-Schemas.md#discountline) | yes | The automatic discount, if any, then the code. |
| `quote.amount` | string | yes | Toman left to pay, never below zero; 0 means free. |

### StoreCustomServices

«سرویس دلخواه» as a customer meets it: each quantity's tiers, bounds and buttons, the devices and the servers. While nothing is `offered`, each quantity's `tiers` and `options` are empty.

| Field | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `offered` | boolean | yes | Whether a service may be built now (`shop.custom_services` of `GET /`). |
| `traffic` | [StoreCustomQuantity](#storecustomquantity) | yes | The GB: `from` and the bounds in GB, a tier's `price` per GB. |
| `days` | [StoreCustomQuantity](#storecustomquantity) | yes | The days: `from` and the bounds in days, a tier's `price` per day. |
| `devices` | integer | yes | Devices at once on a built service; 0 — unlimited. |
| `servers` | list of [NamedRef](API-Schemas.md#namedref) | yes | The servers a service may be built on now, in order; empty while nothing is offered. |

### StoreExtraOffer

What a service can buy of one extra: the preset amounts with their prices and, when there is a unit price, any amount within `custom`. Every price comes twice, as a plan's does: as the shop sets it (`price`) and as the customer's order is charged (`offer_price`: less their largest automatic discount, `discount`, as the bot's buttons show it; a discount code comes off that at checkout). Devices are priced for 30 days and charged for the days left of the period in use (`days`), which they last: every price here is already that share, rounded up to whole Toman.

| Field | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `price` | string or null | yes | Toman per GB, per day or per device (for the days left of the period in use), before the customer's automatic discount; null when only the preset amounts are sold. A custom count of devices is prorated as a whole, so it may cost a few Toman less than this times the count. |
| `offer_price` | string or null | yes | What the customer pays per GB, day or device: `price` less their automatic discount (`discount`); equal to `price` when none applies, null with it. An amount typed is priced as a whole — `price` times it (a custom count of devices prorated as a whole), less `discount.percent` of that rounded down to whole Toman —, so it may cost a few Toman less than this times the amount. |
| `discount` | [StorePlanDiscount](#storeplandiscount) or null | yes | The automatic discount in the `offer_price`s: a sale on extras of the service's plan (for a service without a plan, a sale of every plan), the customer's personal percent or their loyalty tier's, whichever takes most (never two together). Null for none. |
| `options` | list of object | yes | The preset amounts, smallest first. |
| `options[].quantity` | integer | yes | GB, days or devices. |
| `options[].price` | string | yes | Its price in Toman, before the customer's automatic discount. |
| `options[].offer_price` | string | yes | What the customer's order is charged for it, in Toman: `price` less their automatic discount (`discount`). The amount to show, and to send as `expected_amount` (with a discount code, the `amount` of `POST /discount-codes/check` instead). |
| `custom` | object or null | yes | Any amount in this range can be bought at `price` per unit (`offer_price` after the automatic discount); null when only the preset amounts are sold. |
| `custom.min` | integer | yes |  |
| `custom.max` | integer | yes |  |
| `days` | integer or null | yes | For devices: the days their prices are charged for, which they last — what is left of the period in use (whole days, at least 1) until its end date, or until a renewal bought before then begins; its whole term while it waits for its first connection; or 30 for one that never ends. Null for traffic and time. |

| `extras.time` | [StoreExtraOffer](#storeextraoffer) or null | yes | Extra time in days; null when none can be bought now. |
| `extras.devices` | [StoreExtraOffer](#storeextraoffer) or null | yes | Extra devices (the IP limit); null when none can be bought now. Their prices are for the days left of the period in use (`days`), which they last. |

### StoreNameModeInput

How the new service is named on its panel: `sequential` (left out: the default) by the shop's pattern; `random`, a name drawn now; `custom`, `client_name`. Only a way `shop.name_modes` of `GET /` offers; another is a 422 on `name_mode`. A random name is worked out from the `Idempotency-Key`, so two requests sent with one key at once ask the same; a request repeated with its key asks the name its order was made with, and is not refused for what took that name since.

[ClientNameMode](#clientnamemode).

### StoreNoticeType

The kind of notice; one for each message the bot sends a customer on its own. Payments: approved (the service delivered or the wallet charged, or the delivery failed and support will finish it), an online payment that came in once its order had closed (its money put in the wallet), receipt rejected, order cancelled by support, payment refunded to the wallet, wallet top-up refunded, payment reminder. «انتقال موجودی»: money they sent another customer from their wallet (kept here whichever door they used; in Telegram only when they sent it from the website), money another customer sent them. Services: switched off, back on, deleted, moved (with its new link), given away by support («انتقال سرویس», to its previous owner) or received from another customer (to its new one), given days or traffic; reminders («یادآوری») of a service ending soon or running low on traffic; auto-renewal («تمدید خودکار») done, short of money, or paid but not delivered. Referrals: a new customer joined through their link, a commission, a commission taken back (the wallet top-up that earned it refunded), a start gift («هدیه شروع», for the referrer or the new customer), a free service for invitations («جایزه دعوت»). Agency: request approved or rejected, agency changed or ended, the bot's traffic too low for an order. Account security: two-factor sign-in turned off (by support or by them) or on, a way in added or removed, a password set, another account merged into it, the second step locked after failed codes, emailed codes locked after failures (these go to every channel they have: Telegram and email). Tickets: support's answer, and closing. Rewards: moved up a loyalty tier («سطح وفاداری»), cashback earned («کش‌بک»), won the nightly draw («قرعه‌کشی شبانه»).

String: `payment_settled`, `payment_credited`, `payment_rejected`, `order_cancelled`, `payment_refunded`, `topup_refunded`, `wallet_sent`, `wallet_received`, `payment_reminder`, `service_disabled`, `service_enabled`, `service_deleted`, `service_moved`, `service_transferred`, `service_received`, `service_granted`, `expiry_reminder`, `traffic_reminder`, `auto_renewed`, `auto_renew_short`, `renewal_failed`, `referral_joined`, `referral_commission`, `referral_commission_back`, `referral_start_gift`, `referral_reward`, `agency_approved`, `agency_rejected`, `agency_changed`, `agency_revoked`, `agency_traffic_short`, `agency_expiring`, `agency_minimum_short`, `agency_suspended`, `agency_resumed`, `two_factor_disabled`, `way_in_added`, `way_in_removed`, `password_changed`, `two_factor_enabled`, `account_merged`, `second_step_locked`, `email_codes_failed`, `ticket_answered`, `ticket_closed`, `loyalty_tier_up`, `cashback_earned`, `lottery_won`.

### StorePayLink

An online gateway's page to pay a payment on: the customer pays there, and the gateway tells the shop by itself.

| Field | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `payment_id` | integer | yes | The payment it pays: the one to ask about (`POST /payments/{id}/check`). |
| `url` | string | yes | The gateway's page: open it (a link or a redirect) for the customer to pay there. For AqayePardakht, a page on the shop's own address that leads on to the bank's (the bank opens its page only for a visitor coming from the gateway's verified address). |
| `expires_at` | string (date-time) or null | yes | Until when the page takes money: the gateway's own end, or the time the shop keeps its page when the gateway gives none. A request made again with its `Idempotency-Key` answers the same page while it has more than 3 minutes left, else a new one. |
| `amount` | string | yes | The sum to pay, in Toman: the payment's own, or more when the gateway adds a few Toman to tell transfers apart (CubePay, AbanGateway) or the customer pays the gateway's fee (`fee`). Show this one as what to pay. A page may still ask it otherwise: Variza's asks a few Toman more of its own, and Plisio's the same in a coin the customer picks there (at the shop's dollar rate). |
| `fee` | string or null | yes | Of `amount`, the gateway's fee the customer pays: the one the shop passes on (CubePay), Zarinpal's when its merchant set the payer to pay it, or what AtlasPay puts on the order's amount; null for none. The order is still paid, delivered and credited at its own amount. |
| `card` | object or null | yes | The card that sum goes to, when the gateway gave one to show (CubePay's «🤖 نمایش کارت در ربات», AtlasPay's «نمایش مستقیم اطلاعات پرداخت», AbanGateway's «نمایش کارت در ربات و سایت» in the shop): the customer may transfer the exact `amount` to it rather than open the page. Null otherwise. |
| `card.number` | string | yes | The card number: 16 digits, no separators. |
| `card.holder` | string or null | yes | The card holder's name, as the gateway gave it; null when it gave none. |
| `card.bank` | string or null | yes | The card's bank, as the gateway gave it; null when it gave none. |

Should the gateway take the money later after all, the shop still settles it. |

| `subscription` | [StoreSubscription](#storesubscription) or null | yes | Once delivered: the service the order created, renewed or added extras to, while it is still the customer's; null otherwise. |

### StoreRenewal

A preview of a service's renewal: on its own plan (or, for a service without one, the plan picked — or the package built, `custom`), at its price today, by a renewal method among those the shop offers, and the service as the renewal would leave it by that method. It uses the last numbers read from the panel; the renewal itself reads the panel when it is paid.

| `methods` | list of [RenewalMethod](API-Schemas.md#renewalmethod) | yes | The methods the shop offers, in this order; the price is the same by each. With more than one, let the customer pick and send it as `method` to the preview and the renewal; with one, there is nothing to pick. |
| `plan` | object or null | yes | The service's own plan, or the one picked (`plan_id`) for a service without one, which the renewal uses: what a renewal gives, as the catalogue says it (`StoreRenewalPlan` without the prices). Null for a package built (`custom`). |

| `plan.name` | string | yes |  |
| `plan.description` | string or null | yes |  |
| `plan.checkout_note` | string or null | yes | A note to show at checkout, as plain text; null for none. |
| `plan.price` | string | yes | Toman. |
| `plan.traffic_gb` | number | yes | Gigabytes, decimals allowed; 0 for unlimited. |
| `plan.duration_days` | integer | yes | Whole days, rounded up; 0 never ends. |
| `plan.duration_hours` | integer | yes | Hours; 0 never ends. |
| `plan.devices` | integer | yes | Devices at once the renewal gives; 0 for no limit — whatever the service has now, extra devices bought included. A running service renewed by `extend` or `reset_traffic` keeps its devices until the period in use ends, and has these from then; any other has them at once (one still waiting for its first connection with the extra devices bought for it on top). |
| `custom` | object or null | yes | The package a service without a plan is renewed with instead (`gb` and `days`): what it gives — its GB, its days and the builder's devices — and each quantity's price by the builder's tiers (`GET /custom-services`). Null for a renewal on a plan. |
| `custom.gb` | integer | yes |  |
| `custom.days` | integer | yes |  |
| `custom.devices` | integer | yes | Devices at once it gives; 0 — unlimited. From when, as a plan's `devices`. |

A discount code is applied on top of this when paying (`discount_code`). |
| `discounts` | list of [DiscountLine](API-Schemas.md#discountline) | yes | The automatic discount in `price`: none, or one. |

By `extend` remaining days carry over, and a period's unused traffic expires when the period ends unless the shop carries it over (see `next_period`); by `reset_traffic` remaining days carry over and the traffic starts afresh; by `reset_time` the term starts afresh and the traffic left carries over. |

### StoreRenewalPlan

A plan a service can be renewed on: what a renewal on it gives, its price, and what the renewal costs the customer today.

| `renewal_price` | string | yes | What renewing on it costs the customer today, in Toman: the plan's agent price for an agent or a «همکار» group member, else its price, minus their largest automatic discount (`discounts`). A discount code is applied on top of this when paying. The preview (`GET …/renewal?plan_id=`) says the same. |
| `discounts` | list of [DiscountLine](API-Schemas.md#discountline) | yes | The automatic discount in `renewal_price`: none, or one. |

### StoreResponse

The Store API's `GET /`: the shop's public profile, which a website asks for first.

| Field | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `shop` | object | yes |  |
| `shop.name` | string | yes | The main shop's name (APP_NAME); for an agent's shop, their bot's title (else its username). |
| `shop.taking_orders` | boolean | yes | Whether the shop takes orders now: its bot is switched on, and — an agent's shop — the main shop has not suspended its selling. When false, purchases, renewals, extras and top-ups are refused (503) — receipts too while the bot is off, but not while the selling is suspended (an order made before is still paid) —, and while the selling is suspended a renewal's preview and a discount code's check for a renewal or an extra are a 422 on `status`; the catalogue can still be read (an agent's suspended shop offers no plan) and customers can still sign in. |
| `shop.service_claims` | boolean | yes | Whether a customer can add a service to their account by its link now (`POST /subscriptions/claim`, «افزودن سرویس با لینک»): the main shop's alone, while its admin switches it on (off by default). Always false in an agent's shop. |
| `shop.service_transfers` | boolean | yes | Whether a customer can hand one of their services to another customer of the shop now (`POST /subscriptions/{id}/transfer`, «انتقال سرویس»): while the shop's admin switches it on (off by default), in any shop. |
| `shop.custom_services` | boolean | yes | Whether a customer can build a service of the traffic and days they choose now («سرویس دلخواه», `GET /custom-services`): the main shop's alone, while its admin switches it on (off by default), both price lists sell and one of its servers can take a new client. Always false in an agent's shop. |
| `shop.name_modes` | list of [ClientNameMode](#clientnamemode) | yes | The ways a buyer may name their new service (`name_mode` of `POST /orders`), `sequential` (the shop's pattern) first and always; `random` and `custom` while the shop's admin offers them. Just `sequential`: ask nothing. |
| `shop.bot` | object or null | yes | The shop's Telegram bot; null while its username is unknown. |
| `shop.bot.username` | string | yes | Without the @. |
| `shop.bot.url` | string | yes | https://t.me/ and the username. |
| `support` | object or null | yes | How to reach support: the bot's «پشتیبانی» contact as a link (an @handle's t.me address, a web address, or a tel: number). Null when none is set or it is not a link. |
| `support.url` | string | yes |  |
| `sign_in` | object | yes |  |
| `sign_in.telegram` | object or null | yes | Telegram sign-in while it is on; null when it is off. |
| `sign_in.telegram.client_id` | string | yes | The Client ID for the site's sign-in (telegram-login.js's client_id). |
| `sign_in.telegram.redirect` | boolean | yes | The redirect flow is also available (a client secret is stored), so `POST /auth/telegram/authorize` works. |
| `sign_in.google` | object or null | yes | Google sign-in while it is on; null when it is off. |
| `sign_in.google.client_id` | string | yes | The OAuth client id for the site's sign-in (Google Identity Services' client_id). |
| `sign_in.email` | boolean | yes | Email sign-up is on and the shop can send email (so the codes reach the customer). Customers who already signed up can sign in with their password either way. |
| `captcha` | object or null | yes | The website's captcha, for drawing the widget; null when none is set. Sign-up, password sign-in, password reset and reviews send its token in `captcha`, solved for the operation's action (`x-captcha`: Turnstile's data-action, or ALTCHA's challenge requested with ?action=). For the site's own forms, its backend checks the token with `POST /captcha/verify`. |
| `captcha.driver` | [CaptchaDriver](#captchadriver) | yes |  |
| `captcha.site_key` | string or null | yes | The widget's public key (Turnstile's site key); null for ALTCHA, which has none. |
| `captcha.challenge_url` | string or null | yes | Where the widget fetches its challenge: ALTCHA's challengeurl (`GET /captcha/challenge`, with ?action= naming the form's action). Null for Turnstile, which makes its own. |
| `referral` | object | yes | The referral program's terms: a new customer who signs in with an invite code (`referral_code`) earns the code's owner a share of their payments. |

| `referral.rate` | integer | yes | The share of a referred customer's payment, in percent. |
| `referral.first_only` | boolean | yes | Only each referred customer's first payment earns a share. |

### StoreSubscription

One of the customer's services, as last read from its panel (`synced_at`), with what the customer can do with it now.

| Field | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | integer | yes |  |
| `name` | string | yes | Its name on the panel ("amir_2", "USER_7"). |
| `status` | [SubscriptionStatus](API-Schemas.md#subscriptionstatus) | yes |  |
| `is_test` | boolean | yes | A free test account («اکانت تست»), taken in the bot: it has no plan and can be neither renewed nor bought extras (`extras`); the shop may remove it some time after it ends, or some days after it was made while never connected (`removes_at`). |
| `claimed_at` | string (date-time) or null | yes | When the customer added it to their account by its link (`POST /subscriptions/claim`, or in the bot): a service support made on the panel by hand, not sold by the shop. It has no plan until a renewal on a plan the customer picks (`GET …/renewal-plans`; a renewal with a package built leaves it without). Null for every other service. |
| `plan` | [NamedRef](API-Schemas.md#namedref) or null | yes | The plan it was sold or last renewed on; null for a service without one — a test account, a service added by its link (`claimed_at`) or built by the customer (`POST /custom-services/orders`), until a renewal on a plan (a renewal with a package built leaves it null). The shop never deletes a plan a service names. |
| `server` | [NamedRef](API-Schemas.md#namedref) | yes | The server it is on («لوکیشن» in the bot). |
| `link` | string or null | yes | The subscription link; null once the panel no longer has the service (deleted). |
| `traffic` | [StoreServiceTraffic](#storeservicetraffic) | yes |  |
| `term` | [StoreServiceTerm](#storeserviceterm) | yes |  |
| `ended_at` | string (date-time) or null | yes | When it ended: its end date passed, its traffic ran out, or its panel no longer has it. Null while it runs, and after its end date until the shop next reads its panel (`term.expires_at` says when). |
| `removes_at` | string (date-time) or null | yes | When the shop will remove it by itself — from its panel and from the customer's services —, by the shop's rules now; null when it will not. Set only for a service that ended (or a test account never connected) in a shop that removes such services: renewing it or adding to it before then keeps it, and the moment can move when the shop changes its rules. A moment already past: it goes at the shop's next check (every 15 minutes). A service switched off by support, or with an order still open (a renewal waiting for its receipt), is not removed. |
| `auto_renew` | object | yes | Auto-renewal («تمدید خودکار»): the service is renewed from the wallet before it ends, on its plan at the plan's price. |
| `auto_renew.on` | boolean | yes | The customer's switch. |
| `auto_renew.offered` | boolean | yes | The switch can be set (`PATCH`): the service is active, has an end date and still has its plan, and the wallet payment method is on and takes the customer's renewal price (within its least and most amount; a service whose renewal it does not take is renewed by hand). |
| `auto_renew.days_before` | integer | yes | How many days before its end it is renewed when the switch is on — or, where the shop renews automatically by «ریست زمان» (which throws away the term left), how many days before its end a wallet short of the price is told, the renewal itself made shortly before the end. A shop-wide setting, 1 to 30. |
| `renewable` | boolean | yes | The customer can renew it now on its own plan: it is active or ended, its plan still exists and the renewal adds something (in an agent's shop, covered by the agent's traffic). False for a service without a plan, which `picks_plan` covers. Whether the shop lets it be renewed yet is `renewal_window`. |
| `picks_plan` | boolean | yes | The customer can renew it now on what they pick: it has no plan and is no test account (added by its link, `claimed_at`, or built), it is active or ended, and a plan on sale is sold on its server or the shop's builder is offered. List the choices with `GET …/renewal-plans` and send the plan picked as `plan_id` to `…/renewal` — that renewal makes it the service's plan, after which `renewable` is what holds —, or a package built as `gb` and `days`, after which it still picks. |
| `renewal_window` | object | yes | Whether the shop lets the customer renew it yet («آستانه مجاز تمدید»), beside `renewable` or `picks_plan`. A shop may hold a running service back until its end date is a few days away, or until little of its traffic is left; an ended service may always be renewed. While closed, the renewal's preview and the renewal are a 422 on `status` saying from when, and the fields say what opens it — any that is set, whichever comes first. Auto-renewal goes by its own days. |
| `renewal_window.open` | boolean | yes | It may be renewed now (as far as the window goes). |
| `renewal_window.opens_at` | string (date-time) or null | yes | While closed: the moment its end date comes within the window (that end date less the window's days); null otherwise. |
| `renewal_window.days_before` | integer or null | yes | While closed and its clock waits for its first connection (no end date yet): it opens this many days before the end date it will have; null otherwise. |
| `renewal_window.traffic_percent` | integer or null | yes | While closed: it opens once at most this percent of its traffic is left; null otherwise (unlimited traffic, or the shop holds nothing back by traffic). With no field set, only its end opens it. |
| `devices` | integer | yes | How many devices may use it at once (its IP limit, raised by extra devices); 0 for no limit. |
| `extras` | object | yes | Whether extra traffic, extra time and extra devices («کاربر اضافه») can be bought for it now (`GET …/extras` gives the amounts and prices). All need the shop to sell them (at its prices or the plan's) and the service to be active or ended (not switched off by support, nor gone from its panel) and not a free test account. Traffic needs a quota and time not run out (a service whose traffic ran out runs again with it). Time needs a term and traffic not run out (a service whose time ran out starts again from its next connection). Devices need a device limit (an unlimited one takes none), neither time nor traffic run out (a renewal then would replace the period they are for at once), and a server whose panel enforces the limit. In an agent's shop, traffic also needs the agent's bot to have traffic left to sell. |
| `extras.traffic` | boolean | yes |  |
| `extras.time` | boolean | yes |  |
| `extras.devices` | boolean | yes |  |
| `link_rotation` | boolean | yes | Its link can be changed now (`POST …/rotate-link`): it is active and its server can rotate links. |
| `next_period` | [StoreNextPeriod](#storenextperiod) or null | yes | A renewal's traffic queued after the current period. Null while none waits for the period's end: nothing renewed ahead, or a renewal whose traffic counted at once (the shop carries unused traffic over, `reset_traffic`, or unlimited traffic) — its device limit may still wait (`next_devices`). |
| `next_devices` | [NextDevices](API-Schemas.md#nextdevices) or null | yes | A renewal's device limit queued after the current period: a running service renewed by `extend` or `reset_traffic` keeps the devices it has (extra devices bought included) until the period in use ends, and has the renewal's from then. Null while the limit stays as `devices` says. |
| `presence` | object or null | yes | Whether it is connected. Only set right after the panel was read (`POST …/refresh`) and still has it; null otherwise. |
| `presence.online` | boolean or null | yes | Connected right now; null when the panel cannot tell. |
| `presence.last_online_at` | string (date-time) or null | yes | Its last connection; null if never, or when the panel cannot tell. |
| `synced_at` | string (date-time) or null | yes | When the panel was last read for it; the numbers are from then. |
| `created_at` | string (date-time) | yes |  |

| `transfer.left_today` | string or null | yes | What the daily cap leaves this customer today; null without a cap. |
| `transfer.most` | string | yes | The most they may send now: `max`, their balance (never below '0.00') and `left_today`, whichever is least. Below `min`, they can send nothing now. |
| `top_up` | object | yes | The top-up limits, presets and random amounts, as the bot's «افزایش موجودی» offers them. `POST /wallet/top-up` accepts these amounts exactly as written here. |
| `top_up.min` | string | yes | The smallest top-up allowed. |
| `top_up.max` | string | yes | The largest top-up allowed. |
| `top_up.presets` | list of string | yes | The amounts offered as buttons, ascending. |
| `top_up.random` | list of string | yes | Amounts drawn at random for this answer, offered as buttons after the presets, ascending: as many as the shop's settings ask (none by default), each within the shop's range for them and never below `min`, rounded as the shop asks, none twice and none a preset. Each answer draws anew. |
